evaluationType: Historical model-family validation on weather labels and resolved market payouts.

method.selection: Within each family and outer target month, configuration selected using an earlier inner validation month; selected configurations differ by month. Aggregate primary metrics use zero-embargo outer tests only.

weatherEvaluation.target: Bucket membership of realized weather high (weather-derived binary label)
weatherEvaluation.rowDefinition: Forecast/bucket/decision-time validation rows, not independent trades or unique weather events.

marketDiagnostic.target: Resolved Polymarket payout of the quoted YES or NO side
marketDiagnostic.rowDefinition: Matched market/decision-time/side rows; related YES/NO sides and repeated times are not independent events.
marketDiagnostic.verdict: Market midpoint outperformed the candidate on both Brier score and log loss.
marketDiagnostic.explanation: Weather-derived labels and resolved market payouts are different targets; do not compare the weather panel numbers directly with market panel numbers.

cityHoldout.passDefinition: Improves both Brier score and log loss versus baseline on a held-out city.

regionHoldout.passDefinition: Improves both Brier score and log loss versus baseline on a held-out region.

limitations: Aggregate scores describe a historical research evaluation. The public dashboard generates its execution examples separately from fictional inputs.
Configurations were selected on an earlier inner month within each family and outer month. Primary scores use the six zero-embargo outer tests from January through June 2026.
Weather-derived labels and market settlement labels use different populations. Compare scores within each target.
Several rows share a city-date event, decision time, or complementary market side. Row totals include correlated observations.
The reported 95% weather improvement interval uses 200 city-date cluster bootstrap resamples across 2,718 clusters.
The candidate missed city and region holdout requirements. The market midpoint obtained lower Brier score and log loss on the payout target.
Same-day rows can use a point-in-time observed high. The wider weather evaluation includes more forecast horizons than the one- and two-day signal screens.
